question: Which further lords and directional groups are included in the purifiable enumeration?
premises: The list continues with Brahmā, the lord of the sage-world, and Rudras.
Some Rudras are located in five intermediate regions.
Eastern figures named Kapāli, Vahni, Anta, Nirṛti, and Bala are included.
inference: The enumeration combines named lords with intermediate and directional placements.
uncertainties: The exact referents of Anta and Bala in this directional set are not fully certain from the verse alone.
plain_english: The list continues with Brahmā, the lord of the sage-world, and Rudras stationed in five intermediate regions. In the lower Ananta and in the east are those named Kapāli, Vahni, Anta, Nirṛti, and Bala.
